blocks.heading: Fresher Hiring Volume Entry-Level Hiring
rows: Fresher hiring volume
Entry-level hiring fell 10% year on year in July 2026, so the first job is harder to land than the BBA brochure suggests.
foundit Insights Tracker, July 2026
Sales and business development
Its share of fresher hiring rose from 18% to 20%, the highest among the non-IT functions the report lists, and it is a door open to BBA graduates.
Who gets hired
Management and commerce graduates were 32% of fresher hiring against 42% for STEM graduates. 15% of fresher postings named no educational qualification.
Internships
Nearly six in ten fresher postings prefer or require prior internship experience. Only 42% accept candidates with none.
AI-linked roles
AI-led roles were 4% of fresher hiring, up from about 1% a year earlier. Just over half of those (51%) are AI operations work such as data analysis and testing, not model building.
Skills and proof

Employer intent to hire freshers reached 73% in the first half of 2026, in a survey of 1,051 employers. Employers are moving from degree filters to skills, proof of work and behaviour, and marketing is shifting toward analytics.
TeamLease EdTech Career Outlook, HY1 2026

blocks.heading: Ten BBA Routes, Rated for the Future
rows: Digital and performance marketing
Scalable
Marketing and communications had the strongest year-on-year growth of any group in July 2026, at 22%. That figure covers all hiring, not only freshers.
Results are measurable, so one skill serves many businesses. Start with one test for a local business and record the result, then freelance, then a small agency.
Data and business analytics
Scalable
Big data specialists top the World Economic Forum list of fastest-growing roles worldwide, and the same report expects more demand for business intelligence analysts.
Reports, dashboards and audits sell as projects. A BBA graduate usually enters as an analyst and needs Excel, SQL and one dashboard tool first.
Your own business or a family business
Scalable
India had 2,12,283 startups recognised by DPIIT as on 31 January 2026, and 6,789 of them were marked closed, so the route is well travelled and risky.
You own the price, the hiring and the repeat customers. Income is uneven for the first years, so keep a paid skill running beside it.
Sales and business development
Scalable with a business layer
Share of fresher hiring rose from 18% to 20%, and the World Economic Forum lists salespersons among the roles adding the most jobs.
Salaried roles run on targets. Selling your own offer or consulting is the business layer, so plan it from the start and keep a written follow-up record from day one.
Business analysis and consulting support
Global capability centres hire in analytics and finance operations, and their share of fresher hiring rose from 8% to 11% in July 2026.
A salaried ladder first. Learn to write a clear requirement document, then process or analytics consulting for small firms is the layer.
HR and people operations
No strong growth signal in the data checked. Demand follows company hiring, so it moves with the economy.
Fixed pay bands. Add HR analytics or hiring-process skill, and a recruitment or HR consulting service is the layer.

items.text: Sales and business development, now 20% of fresher hiring
Marketing that is measured by results, including performance and analytics work
Work inside global capability centres (India offices that big firms run for global work), up from 8% to 11% of fresher hiring
Your own service or business, backed by a paid skill

blocks.heading: What AI Is Cutting in BBA Jobs

items.text: Use AI to draft outreach, summarise research and speed up spreadsheet work
Check every number and claim it gives you before you send it
Keep a short record of what you improved with it, and by how much
Protect customer and company data, and do not paste private files into public tools
